label: Klaviyo
description: Send customer events to Klaviyo for email and SMS marketing automation

fields.label: Public API Key (Site ID)
fields.description: Found in Klaviyo → Account → API Keys

fields.label: Private API Key
fields.description: Found in Klaviyo → Account → API Keys

fields.label: Email List ID
fields.description: Klaviyo list ID for subscribing customers who opt in to email marketing

fields.label: Enable SMS Marketing
fields.description: Subscribe customers to SMS marketing when they opt in during checkout

fields.label: SMS List ID
fields.description: Optional: separate Klaviyo list for SMS subscribers. Leave empty to use the Email List ID.

fields.label: Track Checkout Started
fields.description: Send 'Checkout Started' event when a customer begins checkout

fields.label: Track Abandoned Checkout
fields.description: Send 'Abandoned Checkout' event when a cart is abandoned

fields.label: Track Order Submitted
fields.description: Send 'Order Submitted' event when a customer places an order

fields.label: Track Order Fulfilled
fields.description: Send 'Order Fulfilled' event when an order is marked as delivered

fields.label: Track Order Canceled
fields.description: Send 'Order Canceled' event when an order is canceled
